# Getting Started

Welcome to your new instance! This guide will help you get up and running quickly.

## First Steps

1. **Connect to your instance** - Use the Terminal tab to access the console
2. **Configure your environment** - Check the Env tab for environment variables
3. **Deploy your application** - Use the Files tab to upload your code

## Useful Commands

```bash
# Check system status
systemctl status

# View logs
journalctl -u your-service
```

## Next Steps

- Join our [Community](https://example.com/community)
